trends.headline: Yellow line crawling through the Tube
trends.snippet: Twenty-two minutes at Embarcadero and counting. People are walking Market instead.

trends.headline: Announcements say Richmond, signs say Daly City
trends.snippet: Train identity crisis at Montgomery. Half the car got off. Half should have.

trends.headline: Fare gates rejecting cards at Powell
trends.snippet: Tap, red X, try the next gate. Everyone is doing the same dance.

trends.headline: Powell Street elevator out again
trends.snippet: Stairs are a contact sport. Strollers and bikes stacking at the landing.

trends.headline: Millbrae cutoff is a sprint tonight
trends.snippet: If you miss this one you are on a bus and a prayer. Platform is already anxious.

trends.headline: MacArthur bottleneck on the hour
trends.snippet: Three lines, one platform, two announcements that disagree. Classic transfer.

trends.headline: Scooters in the bike car, bikes in the aisle
trends.snippet: The first car is a storage unit. Bring patience, not a frame.

trends.headline: Civic Center packed, next train 12 min
trends.snippet: Doors cycling, nobody moving. The following train is not empty either.

seed.name: Weekend bus bridge
seed.text:
Planned: free buses replace trains Union City ↔ Warm Springs some weekends through September — next work dates Sep 26–27; Green Line note on those work days. https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories
South Bay this weekend — train or the free bus bridge?

seed.name: Peninsula nights
seed.text:
Expect ~30-minute delays starting 9pm some Sun–Thu nights between Millbrae and SFO (train-control modernization; through Summer 2026 per BART). https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories
Late Peninsula run tonight or wait it out?

seed.name: Pleasant Hill single-track
seed.text:
Single tracking near Pleasant Hill for vegetation management — next work day Oct 4 (two tracks → one while active). https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories
Who’s already building buffer into that Concord/Walnut Creek hop?

seed.name: 24th St Mission elevator
seed.text:
24th St. Mission elevator out of service July 13 → Oct 23 (planned elevator advisory). https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories
Mission riders — street-to-platform workaround locked in, or avoiding that gate?

seed.name: BARTable chip
seed.text:
Board meeting video / live links on BART’s official YouTube — outbound only, we don’t re-stream. https://www.youtube.com/BARTable
